name: Ebpf
description: eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) instruction set and conventions

rfc9669.title: BPF Instruction Set Architecture (ISA)
rfc9669.abstract: eBPF (which is no longer an acronym for anything), also commonly referred to as BPF, is a technology with origins in the Linux kernel that can run untrusted programs in a privileged context such as an operating system kernel.  This document specifies the BPF instruction set architecture (ISA).
